slash.name: Quick Slash
slash.desc: A basic physical attack that causes bleeding on the target.

magic_bolt.name: Magic Bolt
magic_bolt.desc: Concentrated pure energy that can shock the opponent.

sora_divine.name: Purifying Gaze
sora_divine.desc: Stares at you with such purity that your sins evaporate. Heals critical wounds of the user.

azki_map.name: AZKi Map
azki_map.desc: Plots a deadly route based on exact coordinates. You can't hide!

roboco_beam.name: High-Spec Beam
roboco_beam.desc: High-tech destructive ray that shocks the opponent.

miko_lava.name: Elite Lava
miko_lava.desc: FAQ! Summons volcanic lava that burns the ground and the enemy.

suisei_axe.name: Stellar Axe
suisei_axe.desc: Psychopathic cut that causes massive inevitable bleeding.

mel_kiss.name: Vampiric Kiss
mel_kiss.desc: A sweet kiss that drains the opponent's life to heal Mel.

fubuki_kon.name: Kon Kon Attack
fubuki_kon.desc: Fast white fox attack that freezes the enemy with pure amazement.

matsuri_god.name: God's Power
matsuri_god.desc: Matsuri unleashes her chaotic divinity, causing an energy explosion.

aki_mukiroze.name: Mukiroze Punch
aki_mukiroze.desc: Aki summons her muscular form to deliver a devastating blow.

haachama_cook.name: Haachama Cooking
haachama_cook.desc: Cooks something horrible that poisons and horrifies the rival.

aqua_sololive.name: Sololive
aqua_sololive.desc: Aqua enters a state of maximum concentration, increasing her damage.

shion_magic.name: Murasaki Mine
shion_magic.desc: Powerful black magic that explodes upon contact.

ayame_nakirium.name: Nakirium
ayame_nakirium.desc: Unleashes adorable energy that heals critical wounds.

choco_exam.name: Medical Exam
choco_exam.desc: A check-up so intense it weakens the rival's defenses.

subaru_shout.name: Duck Shout
subaru_shout.desc: A deafening shout that stuns and confuses the enemy.

mio_tarot.name: Mio's Tarot
mio_tarot.desc: Fate decides if the rival is cursed or if Mio is healed.

rushia_scream.name: Necromantic Scream
rushia_scream.desc: An undead scream that inflicts massive area damage.

luna_nanora.name: Nanora Beam
luna_nanora.desc: Royal laser from the Candy Kingdom that punishes commoners.

coco_breath.name: Dragon Breath
coco_breath.desc: Coco unleashes a legendary flame that incinerates everything.

nene_seal.name: Bear Seal
nene_seal.desc: Nene summons her husbands (bears) to crush the rival.

polka_chaos.name: Polka Chaos
polka_chaos.desc: An unpredictable clown trick that causes random effects.

ame_groundpound.name: Ground Pound
ame_groundpound.desc: Ame jumps and slams the ground, causing a temporal earthquake.

fauna_nature.name: I'm Nature
fauna_nature.desc: Fauna invokes the power of the forest to heal herself and punish the rival.

kronii_blades.name: Time Blades
kronii_blades.desc: Surgical attack with the clock hands of eternity.

mumei_dagger.name: Civilization Dagger
mumei_dagger.desc: A quick, lethal cut that Mumei forgot she was going to give.

baelz_chaos.name: Chaos Dice
baelz_chaos.desc: Roll the dice. The result is always chaotically painful.

irys_hope.name: Explosive Hope
irys_hope.desc: BOOM! A blast of pure, crushing hope.

shiori_story.name: Forbidden Story
shiori_story.desc: Tells you a tale so dark that it drains your luck and health.

bijou_rock.name: Biboo Rock
bijou_rock.desc: Living jewel that crushes rivals with the weight of the Pebbles.

kanata_grip.name: 50KG Pressure
kanata_grip.desc: Grabs you with the strength of a celestial gorilla.

anya_keris.name: Ancestral Cut
anya_keris.desc: Anya reveals her true keris dagger form. The cut is eternal.

gura_bite.name: Shark Bite
gura_bite.desc: Aura! A bite that recovers health for the user.

calli_scythe.name: Death's Scythe
calli_scythe.desc: Spectral cut that drains vital essence.

kiara_phoenix.name: Phoenix Rebirth
kiara_phoenix.desc: Eternal fire that heals and burns at the same time.

pekora_tnt.name: TNT Trap
pekora_tnt.desc: Explosive gift from Pekoland. Peko Peko Peko!

marine_horny.name: Red Tide
marine_horny.desc: The pirate aura makes all opponents dizzy and confused.

watame_shogun.name: Watame Shogun
watame_shogun.desc: The sheep has done nothing wrong... except this shogun attack.

towa_angel.name: TMT Beam
towa_angel.desc: A beam so angelic it hurts the soul.

botan_ssrb.name: SSRB Tactic
botan_ssrb.desc: Explosive lion. Massive tactical area damage.

lamy_sake.name: Sake Breath
lamy_sake.desc: Gets you drunk and freezes your soul with polar cold.

laplus_darkness.name: YMD! Curse
laplus_darkness.desc: Yamada! The dark leader permanently curses your luck.

noel_knight.name: Knight Mace
noel_knight.desc: A forceful blow from Noel that stuns the enemy.

flare_arrow.name: Igneous Arrow
flare_arrow.desc: Flare's elf precision with a fatal fiery touch.

okayu_onigiri.name: Mogu Mogu
okayu_onigiri.desc: Steals your Onigiri and your vital energy to heal.

korone_yubi.name: Yubi Yubi!
korone_yubi.desc: Give me your fingers! Fast, frantic, and bloody attack.

lui_whip.name: Officer's Whip
lui_whip.desc: Brings order to the arena with hawk lashes. Get in line!

koyori_potion.name: Coyote Experiment
koyori_potion.desc: Throws a flask with pink liquid that bubbles aggressively.

chloe_stink.name: Orca Scent
chloe_stink.desc: Hasn't bathed in a week. The air around her is a biological weapon.

iroha_slash.name: Kazama-tai Slash
iroha_slash.desc: A katana cut so fast she doesn't even realize she attacked.

moona_moon.name: Lunar Earthquake
moona_moon.desc: Builds a tower on top of your head in milliseconds. Wild construction!

ollie_scream.name: Zombie Scream
ollie_scream.desc: Screams so loud her head falls off, but deals more damage to you.

reine_pavo.name: Royal Fan
reine_pavo.desc: Blows you away with a gust of elegant wind. Peafowl power!

kobo_rain.name: Rain Tantrum
kobo_rain.desc: Cries so much it invokes a localized storm just to annoy you.

kaela_grind.name: Grind Hammer
kaela_grind.desc: Hits you with the weight of 500 hours of uninterrupted farming.

zeta_cat.name: (Not) Cat Stealth
zeta_cat.desc: Appears behind you and stabs you while insisting she's human.

ina_wah.name: Wah Tentacles
ina_wah.desc: Summons the ancients. It's adorable and terrifying at the same time. WAH!

ao_sketch.name: Meme Sketch
ao_sketch.desc: Draws you in an embarrassing situation. You die of pure cringe.

kanade_opera.name: Opera Solo
kanade_opera.desc: Sings so loud that glass (and your bones) break.

ririka_ceo.name: Business Plan
ririka_ceo.desc: Throws a leonine contract at you. The debt kills you slowly.

raden_mask.name: Art Mask
raden_mask.desc: Explains art history to you until you faint from boredom.

hajime_bam.name: BAM! Impact
hajime_bam.desc: A direct hit with the energy of a good-hearted gangster.

raora_panther.name: Artist's Claw
raora_panther.desc: Cuts you with the elegance of an Italian panther. Ciao!

cecilia_toy.name: Toy String
cecilia_toy.desc: Winds you up until your internal organs fail from excess speed.

vivi_spark.name: Vivi Spark
vivi_spark.desc: A burst of bright energy that leaves you blinded.

su_tide.name: Su Tide
su_tide.desc: A wave of purifying water that sweeps the enemy away.

niko_hammer.name: Niko Hammer
niko_hammer.desc: A forceful blow that crushes any resistance.

riona_rhythm.name: Riona Rhythm
riona_rhythm.desc: Synchronized attacks that break the rival's defense.

chihaya_tactic.name: Chihaya Tactic
chihaya_tactic.desc: A brilliant plan executed with surgical precision.

sana_size.name: Galactic Scale
sana_size.desc: Becomes so large your existence becomes insignificant.

iofi.name: Alien Brush
iofi.desc: Paints you in colors that don't exist in this dimension, causing dizziness.

risu.name: Non-stop Nut
risu.desc: An infinite burst of nuts fired at supersonic speed.

nerissa_song.name: Dark Siren Song
nerissa_song.desc: A melody that drains sanity and health, causing an eternal curse.

fuwamoco_bau.name: Combined Bau Bau!
fuwamoco_bau.desc: Synchronized twin attack causing unstoppable bleeding.

elizabeth_justice.name: Crimson Judgment
elizabeth_justice.desc: Elizabeth's sword burns with pure justice, incinerating the guilty.

gigi_gremlin.name: Gremlin Mischief
gigi_gremlin.desc: Throws a burst of stolen items that poison and stun you.

ULT_MICOMET.name: MiComet: Lava Comet
ULT_MICOMET.desc: Miko and Suisei combine powers to summon a massive lava meteor.

ULT_BAKATARE.name: Bakataré: Total Chaos
ULT_BAKATARE.desc: Fubuki, Mio, and Flare unleash a storm of coordinated attacks.

ULT_COUNCIL.name: Council: Time Order
ULT_COUNCIL.desc: Sana, Kronii, Mumei, Fauna, and Bae stop time for a galactic judgment.

ULT_ADVENT.name: Advent: Chaos Rebellion
ULT_ADVENT.desc: Advent unleashes their combined power to destroy any barrier.

ULT_REGLOSS.name: ReGloss: Art Resonance
ULT_REGLOSS.desc: The ReGloss group creates a symphony of artistic and rhythmic attacks.

ULT_IDOL_POWER.name: Idol Shine
ULT_IDOL_POWER.desc: Unleashes the power of friendship and dreams.

mela_flame.name: Rescue Flame
mela_flame.desc: Unleashes high-intensity fire that inflicts severe burns on the enemy.

kyoko_megaphone.name: Law Megaphone
kyoko_megaphone.desc: Shouts so loudly that it stuns and disorients the rival in combat.

tsuzuri_express.name: Express Package
tsuzuri_express.desc: Runs over the target at breakneck speed causing impact bleeding.

sopia_orbital.name: Orbital Calculation
sopia_orbital.desc: Calculates the exact weak point of the rival applying guaranteed critical damage.
